enki-harness: a free, MIT-licensed test harness for AI filters that refuses to flatter you.
You wrote a safety filter, you wrote its tests, it passes. That proves less than you think: the person who wrote the code wrote the tests, so the tests only check the cases you already thought of.
enki-harness builds the harness for you and adds the parts you'd skip:
Twins: for every case it must catch, a near-identical innocent case it must not flag
Controls: dumb stand-ins (always-allow, always-block) that must fail, or the harness itself is broken
Rules off: switches each rule off, alone and in pairs, to find dead rules and rules that cancel each other out
Attacker slice: written by a different generator t…

articles.author: The Block Research
articles.description:
Layer 2 scaling solutions help blockchains like Ethereum process more activity without forcing every transaction to happen directly on the base chain.
Ethereum’s main network is secure and decentralized, but blockspace is limited. When demand rises, fees increase and users can get priced out. Layer 2s address this by moving transaction activity to scaling systems that sit around Ethereum while still using it for settlement, security, data posting, or verification.
The most important Layer 2 designs today are rollups. Rollups process transactions off-chain, bundle them together, and post data or proofs back to Ethereum. This makes transactions cheaper and faster while keeping a connection to Ethereum’s trust foundation.
articles.title: Layer 2 Scaling Solutions
